newsitem.title: DUBAI: United Arab Emirates shares end week on even keel.
newsitem.headline: United Arab Emirates shares end week on even keel.

text.p: Shares on the informal United Arab Emirates market ended the week to Thursday on an even keel with the index little changed, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index ended the week over six points higher at 2,447.86 from 2,441.52.
Market leader Etisalat was steady at 955.
The biggest gainer was al-Khazna Insurance which went up to 280 dirhams from the previous week's 245. Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank added five dirhams to 300.
Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co shares kept up their gains, adding 15 dirhams at 1,015.
For the second week running Dubai Islamic Bank was weaker, falling to 175 from 178 dirhams.
